name: Asymbescaline
summary: Asymbescaline (ASB), also known as 3,4-diethoxy-5-methoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of mescaline in which the methoxy groups at the 3 and 4 positions have been replaced with ethoxy groups.

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known mainly from Alexander Shulgin's work on mescaline analogues.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，主要見於 Alexander Shulgin 對麥斯卡林類似物的研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，主要见于 Alexander Shulgin 对麦斯卡林类似物的研究。

sideEffects.en: Almost nothing is known about it in people. Mescaline-like psychedelics can cause nausea, vomiting, anxiety, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and confusion, and can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎一無所知。類麥斯卡林的迷幻藥可能造成噁心、嘔吐、焦慮、心跳與血壓上升以及混亂，並可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎一无所知。类麦斯卡林的迷幻药可能造成恶心、呕吐、焦虑、心跳与血压上升以及混乱，并可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: The scalines are a family of mescaline relatives, and this one is called asymbescaline because its three ether groups are not all the same, making the molecule asymmetric.
fact.zh: scaline 類是麥斯卡林親屬的一個家族，而這個化合物之所以叫 asymbescaline，是因為它的三個醚基並不相同，使分子呈不對稱。
fact.zhHans: scaline 类是麦斯卡林亲属的一个家族，而这个化合物之所以叫 asymbescaline，是因为它的三个醚基并不相同，使分子呈不对称。
